title: AXI4-Stream Packet Under Backpressure
description: Follow a three-beat packet from source to destination; inspect the stalled final beat to see that TDATA, TKEEP, TLAST, TID, and TDEST remain stable until TVALID and TREADY handshake.

annotations.message: No transfer occurs because TVALID is LOW, even though the destination is ready.
Packet beat D0 transfers on this rising edge because TVALID and TREADY are both HIGH.
Packet beat D1 transfers. TID and TDEST remain associated with the stream route.
The final beat is offered with TLAST=1, but TREADY is LOW. No transfer occurs, so every payload and sideband field must remain stable.
The same final beat now transfers. TLAST marks the packet boundary and TKEEP=0011 says only two byte positions carry data.
After the handshake, the source can deassert TVALID and change the payload fields.
